## PolycubeSolver v1.0.0

First public release of **PolycubeSolver** - a free browser-based **Soma Cube solver** and **3D polycube puzzle designer**.

**[Play live](https://stefanvlad0.github.io/PolycubeSolver/)**

### Highlights

- Design up to 7 polycube pieces and custom target shapes in 3D
- Solve packing puzzles with an exact-cover solver (Dancing Links / Algorithm X)
- Browse solutions with orbit, zoom, and explode view
- Soma Cube preset with verified counts: 11,520 raw · 480 (rotation) · 240 (rotation + mirror)
- Runs entirely in the browser - no install required

### What's included

- Interactive 3D editor with Soma preset and blank canvas
- Web Worker solver with live progress and symmetry dedupe options
- Intro animation + onboarding tutorial
- MIT licensed, open source
